main_text.p: Cauendum au, tne unqua membris principalibus, ut cerebro, cordi, iecori adhibeantur: neq; pueris, senioribus, grauidis, ac alijs imbecilioribus applicentur.
main_text.l: Oleum crudu digitis aut penna in os dimissum.
Ista in aqua decoquuntur, et cum oleo uel unctuosis assumuntur.
A cibo sumuntur ad unc. iij. Sumpturis ista uehementiora, confert præsumere paucu cibum: neq; hæc imperari debet nisi ubi stragus latus suspicio imminet.

page.notes: The synopsis is printed as a bracketed outline; the right-hand brace groups give the directions for use ("Sumuntur cum unctuosis, uel sine"; "Ista in aqua decoquuntur..."; "A cibo sumuntur ad unc. iij..."). Left-margin fragments belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. The word "Aduerten-" is a catchword at lower right.
